value.rationale: Power dominating set placement is a natural monitoring problem with significance beyond the minimum cardinality. The complete characterization of all optimal locations on two dual Platonic skeletons shows a sharp geometric contrast (only distance-three pairs versus every pair) and determines exact required force rounds. Its line-graph exchange identification, connectivity and diameters describe whether and how optimum monitoring configurations can be continuously rearranged. These are natural complete equality-case classifications, not arbitrary subset slices or re-statements of a known minimum.
